name: alwrity_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the alwrity capability.

prompts.name: content_strategy_prompt
prompts.template: Generate a content strategy plan for the marketing goals: {marketing_goals}
prompts.use_case: Automating digital marketing content creation and publication

prompts.name: content_generation_prompt
prompts.template: Create {content_parameters.format} content about {content_parameters.topic} with a {content_parameters.tone} tone and {content_parameters.length} length.

prompts.name: seo_optimization_prompt
prompts.template: Provide SEO optimization suggestions based on these keywords: {seo_keywords}
prompts.use_case: Optimizing content for SEO with AI insights

prompts.name: analytics_summary_prompt
prompts.template: Summarize insights and performance from this campaign data: {analytics_data}
prompts.use_case: Managing multiple social media accounts from a single platform
